notes_for_editor: The only source for the tower is the Eastern US Lookouts page: name, county, '100-foot steel tower', and nothing on date, agency or status. The record point (29.04499, -81.97966) comes from that page's map widget. Wikipedia gives Candler's centre as 29.07111, -81.96806, about 3 km north-east of the record point by my calculation, so the point may be off; check imagery before relying on it. The agency field holds a description, see corrections. Two searches found no lookout at Candler, and the 2015 Florida Chapter lookout report does not name Candler. Access and status stay unknown; the story says no source describes the site today.
